name: IHG One Rewards Credit Card

welcome_offer.description: Launch offer: earn 125,000 bonus points after you spend $2,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.
notes: Official Chase page checked 2026-10-02: the former Traveler URL redirects to the IHG One Rewards Credit Card ($0 annual fee; up to 17X at IHG; 3X gas, dining and grocery).

earning_rates.notes: 17x total points per $1 at IHG Hotels & Resorts (5x from card + 6x IHG members + 6x as Platinum elite)

other_benefits.name: Automatic Gold Status
other_benefits.description: IHG Rewards Gold status (20% bonus on base points, priority late checkout)

other_benefits.name: Fourth Night Free
other_benefits.description: Fourth night free on award stays (automatically applied)

sources.notes: Official Chase page checked 2026-10-02: IHG One Rewards Credit Card, $0 annual fee, launch offer 125,000 points after $2,000 in 3 months.

notes: No AF version of IHG card. Lower earning than Premier (17x vs 26x at IHG) and no free night per year, but Gold status (not Platinum) and $0 AF. Good for occasional IHG guests who don't want to pay an annual fee. The 4th night free still applies to award bookings.

recurring_credits.name: DoorDash Non-Restaurant Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $10 off one qualifying non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter (DashMart, 7-Eleven, CVS, Safeway, etc.). Requires active DashPass enrollment. Per Chase cobrand-doordash terms.
